items.name: Berkeley November Weekday 2025

venue.name: Hearst Field Annex B5
venue.details: This venue is not in the same MLK Student Union building.

items.information: ## IMPORTANT: This competition is happening on a weekday, not a weekend * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.

items.name: Boards & Cubes Venteira III 2025
items.information: Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](hhttps://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63095-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63096-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 10%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63099-associados-aps-aps-associates). • If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63095-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63096-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 10% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BoardsCubesVenteiraIII2025#63099-associados-aps-aps-associates). • ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI1MTQ3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--620d0e8364cbb5eb2ae50c7b053125f8f9a30036/4.png) **Espetadores podem assistir gratuitamente! | Spectators may attend for free!** **Apenas será permitido um convidado junto à zona de competição enquanto o respetivo competidor estiver a competir. | Only one guest will be allowed near the competitor area for as long as their corresponding competitor is competing.**

items.name: Rudny Open 2025
items.information: Rundy Open 2025 – Рудный қаласындағы екінші ресми жарыс. Бір санатқа қатысу үшін бастапқы жарна – 2000 теңге. Бұл жарысты QBERS командасы ұйымдастырады. English: Rundy Open 2025 – the second official competition in Rudny. The basic fee for participation in 1 event is 2000 tenge. This competition is organized by the QBERS team.
